# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityTrailingTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _atr_multiplier = 3.0

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._high = IndicatorExtensions.max(
            self.ema(self._equity.symbol, 14, Resolution.DAILY),
            self.ema(self._equity.symbol, 21, Resolution.DAILY)
        )
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._ema_fast = ExponentialMovingAverage(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._ema_fast, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._ema_fast, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self._ema_slow = ExponentialMovingAverage(21)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._ema_slow, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._ema_slow, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self._high = IndicatorExtensions.max(self._ema_fast, self._ema_slow)
        self._atr = self.atr(self._equity.symbol, 14, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        self._stop_loss = StopLoss(3 * self._atr)
        self._has_position = False
        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._equity.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._equity.symbol, 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if not self._has_position:
            self.set_holdings(self._equity.symbol, 1)
            self._has_position = True
        bar = self._equity.bar
        if not bar:
            return
        price = bar.close
        if price > self._high.current.value:
            self._high.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        if self._stop_loss.is_active:
            return
        atr = self._atr.current.value
        stop_price = price - (self._atr_multiplier * atr)
        if stop_price < self._high.current.value:
            self._stop_loss.update(bar.end_time, stop_price)
    
    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            self._has_position = bool(order_event.direction)
